title: Tech Lead - IT Onboarding
description: Que tal ter a chance de ser dono do seu próprio negócio dentro de uma empresa sólida e com mais de 40 anos de história? Conhecimento de SOLID e boas práticas de programação. Familiaridade com bancos relacionais e NoSQL. Noções de testes unitários e automação (Cypress, Postman). Desejável experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (DataDog, Azure Monitor, NewRelic, Splunk) Competências comportamentais: Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe. Organização, atenção a detalhes e mentalidade de dono. Autonomia, proatividade e foco em aprendizado contínuo. title: Mobile Staff Software Engineer

Global Experience Design is one of Nubank’s building blocks, bringing together UX, design, and customer experience. What We’re Looking For Must Have: Proven and solid experience in technical development of mobile applications at a strategic leadership level. Strong technical background with Flutter and/or native mobile development (Android/iOS). Solid understanding of mobile software engineering principles, architectural patterns, and modularization strategies. Experience with server driven UI, performance optimization, dependency injection, and migration of core systems. Knowledge of mobile observability, monitoring, and debugging tools. Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences. Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Nice to Have: Experience with backend technologies, especially those integrated with mobile applications. Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale app architecture. Contributions to internal SDKs, libraries, or mobile design systems. Understanding of user authentication, session management, and app state handling. Leadership in global teams. Why Join Us Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions. Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on. Innovation-Driven Culture: Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. Career Growth: Develop as a strategic engineering, working on complex technical and organizational challenges. title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description: Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together. Position Summary This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature‑based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green‑Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives. Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self‑motivated, creative team member integral to the long‑term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue‑carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries. Responsibilities International Ocean Policy Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals. Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities. Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program. Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources. Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners). Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs. Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities. Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy. As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives. Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs. Blue Climate Program Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed. Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects. Other duties as assigned by supervisor. Working Conditions Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required. Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions. This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process. Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones. Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events. This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora. Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment. Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills. Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment. Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team. Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society. Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience. Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes. Fluency in written and spoken English. Preferred Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages. Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions Master’s degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field. Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings. To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter. This position will remain open until filled. Applications will be reviewed on June 30, 2026. title: Tax Analyst

knowledge of Power BI or other reporting tools is a plus* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across different business functions* Need to be hands-on, organized and strongly committed with team work**Preferred:*** Experience with ERP systems and tax compliance software is preferred**Benefits** At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:* Competitive salary with performance-based bonus* Relocation support (when applicable)* Comprehensive health and dental insurance* Private pension plan* Meal voucher* Free breakfast and snacks* On-site shiatsu therapy* TotalPass fitness program* Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week)* Birthday day off* Christmas gift card* Educational assistance and language programs* Continuous learning through our Learning Hub**Our Hiring Process**At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.### Why work with us?Create a brighter future for yourself while taking on some of the world’s most complex geoscience challenges. title: Brazil - Hybrid: Senior Software Developer - Platform & Complex Systems
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems (Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting) About This Job Posting This job posting is designed to attract senior‑level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale. This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development. This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection. What You Will Work On Depending on your selected technical track, you will: Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms) For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms. Typical focus areas: Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) SQL and NoSQL databases Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization. Typical focus areas: Full stack or backend development Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency Cost‑aware architectural decisions Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems) For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software. Typical focus areas: Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued) Performance‑critical and system‑level applications Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving Integration with databases, APIs, and external services Working with complex legacy and modernized systems Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability. Typical focus areas: Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation. What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks) Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in: Computer Science Software, Systems, or Engineering disciplines Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams Good communication skills in English Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks. Why Join Landmark Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors Location & Work Model This job posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams. Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs) This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment. Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process. Additional Information This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection. title: Coordenador de Design de Produto
description: A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente. Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo. Coordenador (a) de Design Você terá a missão de ser o guardião estético do design de produto na Zerezes, traduzindo referências e intenções criativas em diretrizes de design viáveis e coerentes com o DNA da marca. Por aqui, trabalhamos com autonomia, senso de dono e responsabilidade pelo que entregamos, sempre buscando evoluir e fazer melhor. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Existe um Brasil inteiro de hotéis e pousadas que vendem forte em outros canais e ainda não aparecem na Decolar. Esse gap é receita parada na mesa, e fechá-lo é a sua missão. Como Account Strategist, você mapeia onde está a oferta que falta, descobre quem decide e traz esses parceiros pra dentro. Abre praça, vai a campo, senta na frente do hoteleiro e fecha. Nada de esperar lead cair no colo. Aqui a caça é sua. Como Você Gera Impacto? Caça a oferta que falta. Cruza dados públicos e sinais de mercado pra achar o hotel certo, onde a demanda já existe, e chega direto em quem decide. Abre a praça e fecha o contrato. Mostra pro hoteleiro quanto ele está deixando passar, usa dados e IA. Toca o pipeline de ponta a ponta. Prospecção, follow-up, negociação e fechamento, com a agenda na sua mão e senso de dono em cada etapa. Entrega o hotel pronto pra vender. Não para no contrato assinado: garante que o parceiro entra bem configurado e já começa a girar. Mantém a liderança no radar. Pipeline limpo e números atualizados, sem ninguém precisar cobrar. O Que Te Diferencia Você é hunter de verdade. Tem histórico de fechar, curte o jogo de abrir porta e não trava no primeiro "não". Negocia olho no olho. Vivência sólida em reunião presencial, fechando na mesa. Roda com autonomia total. Gere a própria agenda, se vira sozinho e assume o resultado. Pé na estrada não te assusta. CNH ativa, dirige e topa viagem recorrente pelo Brasil. Fala a língua do dado. Conforto com KPIs, CRM e análise comercial pra orientar a jogada. Vê IA como alavanca. Usa tecnologia pra vender mais e melhor, não como ameaça. Comunica e conecta. Relacionamento fácil, leitura de sala e visão de negócio. Oferecemos autonomia, impacto real e um ambiente onde você pode criar, aprender e escalar. Integrar uma equipe que valoriza a diversidade e coloca as pessoas no centro. title: Analista de Frotas- Combustível
description: Responsabilidades Planejar, controlar e analisar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento da frota, assegurando a correta gestão do consumo de combustível, a confiabilidade das informações, a otimização dos custos operacionais e a conformidade dos processos. Atuar na geração de indicadores, auditoria de abastecimentos, gestão de fornecedores e suporte técnico à tomada de decisão, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência operacional e sustentabilidade da frota. Principais atividades Monitorar e validar diariamente os abastecimentos realizados pela frota, verificando volumes abastecidos, tipo de combustível, veículos, motoristas e postos utilizados. Gerenciar os saldos de abastecimento por veículo, motorista e período, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria. Controlar e realizar a conciliação dos abastecimentos junto às operadoras de cartão combustível, postos, bandeiras e demais fornecedores. Acompanhar a utilização de cartões de combustível, analisando faturas e identificando inconsistências ou irregularidades. Realizar liberações e bloqueios de abastecimento conforme políticas e regras de negócio estabelecidas pela empresa. Calcular, monitorar e analisar os principais indicadores de desempenho relacionados ao consumo de combustível, incluindo consumo médio (km/l), custo por quilômetro rodado, desvio de consumo e variação de preços por fornecedor. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais diários, semanais e mensais sobre consumo, custos, desempenho operacional e tendências de abastecimento. Desenvolver análises comparativas entre veículos, motoristas, rotas e unidades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria. Identificar padrões de consumo atípicos, divergências entre quilometragem e abastecimento, bem como possíveis desperdícios. Elaborar projeções de consumo e despesas com combustível para apoio ao planejamento orçamentário. Acompanhar a evolução dos preços dos combustíveis por região e fornecedor, subsidiando negociações comerciais e estratégias de abastecimento. Propor ações para redução de custos e aumento da eficiência operacional por meio da análise de dados e indicadores. Participar da elaboração, acompanhamento e controle do orçamento de combustível da frota. Auditar divergências entre abastecimentos realizados e parâmetros operacionais esperados, verificando possíveis inconsistências ou desvios. Acompanhar a regularidade fiscal dos abastecimentos, conferindo documentos fiscais e apoiando processos relacionados à legislação tributária aplicável. Identificar indícios de fraudes, irregularidades ou não conformidades nos processos de abastecimento, reportando-os à gestão para as providências cabíveis. Atuar como referência técnica para esclarecimento de dúvidas relacionadas às políticas de abastecimento, utilização de cartões, postos credenciados e limites operacionais. Apoiar a implantação, parametrização e melhoria de sistemas de gestão de combustível, telemetria e monitoramento da frota. Ministrar orientações e treinamentos para motoristas e equipes operacionais quanto aos procedimentos e políticas de abastecimento. Participar de projetos voltados à eficiência energética, redução de custos operacionais e sustentabilidade da frota. Capacitação Formação e Experiência Profissional Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em gestão de frotas, logística, transportes ou áreas correlatas. Vivência em controle e gestão de abastecimento de frotas. Experiência na elaboração de indicadores gerenciais, análise de dados e controle de custos. Atuação com processos de conciliação de abastecimento, auditoria e relacionamento com fornecedores. Requisitos, Qualificações Técnicas e Competências-Chave Requisitos Obrigatórios Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, funções de busca, fórmulas, gráficos e análise de dados). Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de frotas e abastecimento, como GTrack, Logtrack, Sismetrix, Cobli, Geotab ou similares. Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de combustível, como Ticket Log, Sem Parar, Veloe, Gazola ou similares. Capacidade de análise de grandes volumes de dados e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais. Conhecimento dos principais indicadores de desempenho de combustível, como consumo médio (km/l), custo por quilômetro rodado, desvios de abastecimento e eficiência operacional. Conhecimento em processos de auditoria e conciliação de abastecimentos. Diferenciais Conhecimento em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de Business Intelligence. Vivência com sistemas de telemetria e monitoramento em tempo real. Conhecimento sobre tributação aplicada ao combustível (ICMS, PIS, COFINS e demais aspectos fiscais). Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) categoria B ou superior. Curso de especialização ou certificação em Gestão de Frotas, Logística ou áreas correlatas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Preparar o carro de distribuição das refeições servidas para os pacientes, incluindo desjejum, almoço, merenda jantar e ceia. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Preparar e distribuir café, sucos, saladas etc; Preparar carro de distribuição e servir refeições aos pacientes e empregados; Recolher e lavar louças e utensílios; Montar e distribuir dietas aos pacientes, conforme mapa de dietas definido pelas Nutricionistas; Efetuar a higienização da área de trabalho; Utilizar os equipamentos de proteção individual; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. description: IMPA-CNRS postdoctoral fellowships in Mathematics The “Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada” (IMPA) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, announces a Post-Doctoral Fellowship in Mathematics. This is a one-year position, which may be renewed for one more year by mutual agreement between IMPA and the fellow, aimed at researchers who had or still are associated with the French mathematics academic community. The fellowship provides a tax-free stipend of R$ 9,000.00, accompanied by an additional monthly stipend of R$ 1,000.00 to support academic travels. The position is open to applicants from all areas of Mathematics, both pure and applied. The selected candidate will have the freedom to pursue their own research program and will be required to teach at least one graduate course per year. Collaboration and engagement with IMPA students and researchers are strongly encouraged. Applications for this position should include the items below. research plan; list of publications; the names and contact emails of at least three researchers who have familiarity with the applicant’s work and are able to recommend it. The assigned researchers will receive an e-mail message containing the applicant’s information and instructions on how to submit their letter of recommendation. The deadline for submission of applications is April 15, 2026. Results will be announced by May 2026. The selected candidate is expected to begin his/her activities at IMPA in September 2026. description: Descrição da vaga If you feel that you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference . Contributes to a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive and equitable, and in which everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging. Responsabilidades e atribuições Payroll Processes Process all monthly payroll transactions and ensure compliance with the payroll calendar and deadlines. Perform calculations related to salaries, vacation pay, 13th-month salary, terminations, leaves of absence, allowances, deductions, taxes, and benefits. Ensure the accurate processing of hires, terminations, contractual changes, and employee status updates. Employee Onboarding Manage the full onboarding process, including document collection and scheduling pre-employment medical examinations through the Gupy system. Coordinate and deliver onboarding materials to the Admissions area. Time and Attendance Management Register new employees in the Clockin system. Administer time and attendance records through the MY HR – Clockin portal and ensure proper integration with payroll processing. Accounting Support Process DARF tax payments. Prepare and provide payroll-related information for monthly accounting reconciliations. Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and compliance evidence. Occupational Health and Safety Register employees in the SOC system. Issue Work Accident Reports (CAT) when required. Support employees and service teams with questions related to INSS (Social Security) matters. Ensure confidentiality and security of payroll information and employees’ personal data. Garantir o correto processamento de admissões, desligamentos, alterações contratuais e movimentações funcionais. Atuar no envio, conferência e manutenção das obrigações legais e acessórias, incluindo eSocial, FGTS, INSS, IRRF e demais exigências trabalhistas. Calcular provisões trabalhistas relacionadas à folha, férias e encargos, apoiando controles financeiros e orçamentários. Envio de todas as informações ao e-social Cadastro e pagamento de autônomos e fornecedores: Cadastrar autônomos e fornecedores no sistema de RM labore e no MXM. Homologar nas devidas contas contábeis no MXM; Importar informações do RM labore para realizar pagamentos através do MXM; Admissão de funcionários: Realizar todo o processo de admissão desde a coleta de documentos e solicitação para realização de exame admissional através do sistema Gupy; Entregar Kit admissional para área de admissão; Ponto de funcionários: Cadastro dos novos funcionários no sistema do Clockin Administrar controle de ponto através do portal MY HR - Clockin e devida importações para a folha de pagamento; Apoio contábil: Fazer pagamento dos DARFs; Emissões de informações para conferência contábil mensal. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, evidências de conformidade. Segurança do trabalho Cadastro de funcionários no sistema SOC Emissão de CAT caso seja necessário Apoiar a área de atendimento em caso de dúvidas relacionadas ao INSS; Garantir confidencialidade e segurança das informações salariais e dados pessoais dos colaboradores. Projetos de inovação & mudanças: Apoiar os projetos de melhorias de sistemas; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria sistêmica e automação de processos; Responsabilidades Específicas do Contexto Escolar Apoiar o cumprimento de políticas e exigências regulatórias aplicáveis para a área de Educação. Requisitos e qualificações Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Accounting, People Management, or a related field. Basic English proficiency, with a strong interest in developing and improving language skills. Minimum: 3 years experience Experience Previous experience in payroll and personnel administration processes. Experience with RM Labore system. Experience in a school or educational environment will be considered a plus. Experience with MXM and Gupy systems is also a plus, as well as experience in educational settings. Knowledge of labor, social security legislation, and eSocial. Technical Knowledge Payroll processing, social charges, and statutory obligations. Labor and social security legislation. Payroll and time and attendance systems. Google Workspace. Advanced Excel/spreadsheet skills. Data analysis and payroll calculation review. --- Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas. Inglês básico , com grande interesse em desenvolvimento e aprimoramento do idioma. Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência . Experiência Experiência prévia em processos de folha de pagamento e rotinas de departamento pessoal. Experiência com o sistema RM Labore. Experiência em ambiente escolar ou educacional será considerada um diferencial. Experiência com os sistemas MXM e Gupy também será um diferencial, assim como vivência em ambiente educacional. Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e eSocial. Conhecimentos Técnicos Processamento de folha de pagamento, encargos sociais e obrigações legais. Legislação trabalhista e previdenciária. Sistemas de folha de pagamento e controle de ponto. Google Workspace. Excel/planilhas em nível avançado. THE POSITION Reporting to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager owns the design, implementation and performance of the customer care strategy for General Public ticket buyers across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ticketing and hospitality operation. The role translates FIFA’s ticketing requirements and the tournament’s sales strategy into a working service model (service levels, escalation paths, vendor standards) and leads the resources responsible for delivering it. Given the tournament’s international buyer base, the role carries direct accountability for service quality to overseas clients, including language coverage, time-zone alignment and cross-border payment and fraud edge cases. Define and own the customer care strategy and operating model across every channel (contact forms, call center, chatbot, email, and any added over time), setting the direction that Coordinators, Specialists and outsourced teams execute day to day. Own the end-to-end relationship with outsourced customer care and call center providers — contract terms and SLAs, onboarding and setup, ongoing performance management, and renewal or renegotiation decisions when service falls short. Define the training curriculum and certification standards for customer care and call center staff, aligned to the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing regulations, and hold providers and team leads accountable for delivery quality and pass rates. Step into direct customer care delivery (back office and onsite) only for cases requiring Manager-level authority — media-sensitive escalations, VIP-adjacent complaints surfacing through the General Public channel, or capacity gaps during peak on-sale periods and match days. Design and own the escalation governance framework across channels and teams, and act as the final internal escalation point before matters reach the Senior Manager. Set the quality control framework and standards and own the corrective-action decisions when the QA team flags deviations from service requirements. Own the case management strategy inside the CRM — workflow design, automation rules, and the logic for what’s handled automatically versus manually — partnering with the CRM/Digital team on system configuration. Build the business case for, and drive adoption of, productivity and satisfaction improvements — tooling, process redesign, agent enablement — across customer care and call center operations. Identify and report patterns and risks to the Senior Manager and relevant FIFA stakeholders, own the mitigation processes, and elevate anything beyond the team’s authority to resolve. Act as Customer Care’s point of accountability toward FIFA functional areas (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), translating their requirements into operational process and owning any compliance gaps that surface. Define the KPI framework for customer care and call center performance, and use CRM and other systems’ output to make staffing, resourcing and vendor-performance decisions — reporting outcomes to the Senior Manager. Lead the Quality Assurance team: set methodology and standards, and use QA findings to drive corrective action across the wider operation, in-house and outsourced. Own the governance model for the multilingual customer care knowledge base — standards, versioning, ownership — with day-to-day administration executed by the team. YOUR PROFILE SKILLS FRAMEWORK ACCOUNTABILITY Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. DECISION MAKING Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances. INCLUSIVITY Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. INITIATIVE Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. INNOVATION Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. LEADERSHIP Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents. VISION Ability to perceive the organization’s global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in relevant areas. WORK EXPERIENCE Minimum five years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal. Minimum three years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project. Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups. Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events. Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups. Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams. Communication and problem‑solving skills. LANGUAGES Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. TECHNOLOGY Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools CRM software for case management, including automated and manual management of the cases. CERTIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro Right to work in Brazil #J-18808-Ljbffr

Step 3: Entrevista Gestor da Área 3 Entrevista Gestor da Área NÓS SOMOS A AVIATOR. Uma empresa de pessoas para pessoas. Fundada em 1987 como uma pequena boutique de camisas, somos uma marca carioca reconhecida por seu cuidado com o produto. Nosso compromisso com você é criar produtos com matérias-primas e acabamentos superiores, feitos para durar. Nossas lojas traduzem nossa essência e no que acreditamos. Atemporais, sofisticadas e descomplicadas. O exclusivo Azul Aviator, materializado no painel de azulejos e em detalhes surpreendentes na decoração, dá assinatura à marca e personaliza o ambiente. Fazer parte desse time é ter visão de dono, trabalhar em equipe e focado na busca por resultados ancorados em boas relações. Com Colaboradores e com o Cliente. Foi no Rio de Janeiro, no mais carioca dos shoppings, o Rio Sul, que nasceu a primeira loja AVIATOR. Com uma camisaria que impressionava por seu acabamento impecável, modelagem precisa e boa oferta de cores. Ao longo dos anos a marca se estabeleceu como inquestionável destino para quem buscava clássicos do guarda roupa masculino, com preço convidativo e reconhecida qualidade. De lá pra cá, ampliamos a variedade de itens, tendo como fio condutor a atemporalidade de um produto bem feito e livre de modismos. Hoje, temos da t-shirt ao blazer, do tênis ao tricot. Hoje, a AVIATOR está presente em todo o Rio de Janeiro: do Leme ao Pontal, passando pelo Centro, Zonas Sul, Norte e Barra da Tijuca, dando uma esticadinha em Niterói. Em julho de 2024, nossas asas pousaram em SP, com a abertura da 1ª loja no Pátio Paulista, e, em julho de 2025, abrimos a 2ª loja no Shopping Ibirapuera. Em 2011 inauguramos a loja on-line, disponibilizando a marca para consumidores em todo o país. "Um passo a frente você já não está mais no mesmo lugar." Se movimentar é preciso e, na evolução da marca, sabemos que ficar parado não é opção. Ao longo de nossa jornada, entendemos que nosso compromisso vai muito além de oferecer produtos e experiência de compra. Fazer parte ativamente da cena do empreendedorismo brasileiro nos mantém inquietos e fiéis a nossa essência. Não apenas vestimos, mas incentivamos empreendedores brasileiros de maneira ativa. Nosso projeto de incentivo ao empreendedorismo. Através delebuscamos alimentar o ecossistema do empreendedorismo brasileiro e mostrar as novas formas e experiências de trabalho e negócios. Seja contando histórias inspiradoras, seja viabilizando a aceleração de startups promissoras, é através dessa iniciativa que nos conectamos com as próximas empresas de sucesso. EXPANSÃO "Direção é mais importante que a velocidade." Esse é um dos nossos mantras. Não queremos abrir mão de nossa essência enquantocrescemos e nossos passos são pensados e bem dados. Queremos ampliar nosso alcancee levar nossa experiência para todo o Brasil. Pedidos não faltam. Nossas asas em brevepousarão em outras cidades do país. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product Owner Sênior - Plataformas de Exibição
description: Job description Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. área atua na interseção entre os ecossistemas de televisão e produtos digitais da Globo, sendo responsável por plataformas e soluções que garantem a preparação, orquestração, enriquecimento e distribuição de conteúdos para múltiplos canais de consumo. Entre suas responsabilidades estão os processos de preparação de mídia, transcodificação de vídeo, gestão e enriquecimento de informações de grade de programação e suporte às operações de exibição do conteúdo. O time integra iniciativas que atendem desde o ambiente broadcast tradicional até plataformas digitais como Globoplay e parceiros externos, além de disponibilizar informações estratégicas para operadoras e distribuidores. A área possui papel fundamental na jornada de entrega de conteúdo, conectando diferentes sistemas e garantindo que informações de programação e mídia sejam disponibilizadas com qualidade e confiabilidade para diversos públicos e plataformas. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Main responsibilities Como será seu dia a dia: Estratégia e Visão de Produto Traduzir a estratégia de vídeo & streaming em roadmaps táticos mensuráveis, alinhados aos OKRs da área de Distribuição de Mídia. Manter visão de produto de ponta a ponta, abrangendo ingest, media preparation, transcodificação e delivery. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na cadeia de distribuição (QoE, tempo de publicação e custo). Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Garantir a maturidade do backlog, com histórias técnicas e funcionais claras, conectadas ao valor de negócio. Priorizar demandas com base em dados. Agir como decision maker no balanceamento entre inovação, dívida técnica e necessidade operacional dos canais lineares e OTT. Liderança Técnica e Colaboração Trabalhar de forma próxima com equipes de engenharia de vídeo, arquitetura de sistemas e operações de broadcast, garantindo alinhamento nos padrões de integração (API, transcoding workflows, delivery pipelines). Garantir aderência a boas práticas de performance, latency e cost efficiency nos produtos sob sua responsabilidade. Atuar como influenciador técnico junto às áreas de Preparação de Mídia e Produtos para adoção de novos codecs, formatos e protocolos (HEVC, AVC, CMAF, VVC, AV1). Stakeholder Management Coordenar o relacionamento com stakeholders de Conteúdo, Operações, Distribuição e Tecnologia, negociando prazos, escopos e entregas. Participar ativamente de rituais de priorização estratégica e governança de portfólio com foco cross squads. Traduzir insights técnicos em narrativas de negócio claras (benefícios e métricas tangíveis). Métricas e Indicadores de Desempenho Definir e acompanhar KPIs de produto técnico, como: Disponibilidade (SLA, uptime, latência de entrega) Eficiência de codificação (tempo médio, custo por hora processada) Qualidade de experiência (QoE, buffer ratio, bitrate médio) Satisfação interna (NPS técnico das áreas usuárias) Usar métricas para retroalimentar decisões de roadmap e priorização. Requirements and skills Do que você precisa: Vivência em gestão de produtos digitais, tecnologia, mídia ou plataformas de vídeo; Atuação com times multidisciplinares; Experiência em roadmap e visão estratégica responsabilidade direta por definição de backlog e priorização de alto impacto, com entregas medindo sucesso via KPIs; Formação superior completo; Experiência em gestão de produto: Gestão de backlog, priorização, estratégia e visão, roadmap, métricas de produto, okrs, product Discovery; Vivência em agilidade: Scrum, kanban, Jira e métricas; Conhecimentos (intermediário) em desenvolvimento de software: Algorítimo, devops, glossário técnico e sre. Conhecimentos que te destacam: Fortes conhecimentos em métricas de produto, product discovery, conhecimentos técnicos de plataformas digitais, codecs, infra, desenvolvimento de software. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer. title: Fisioterapeuta Visitador | Baixada Fluminense
description: Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades. Principais responsabilidades Realizar atendimentos presenciais de fisioterapia em ambiente domiciliar, promovendo a funcionalidade, autonomia e independência da pessoa idosa. Realizar teleatendimentos de fisioterapia quando indicado pelo plano de cuidado. Avaliar a condição funcional do paciente considerando aspectos físicos, cognitivos, ambientais e sociais. Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar planos de cuidado individualizados, alinhados ao plano assistencial da equipe multiprofissional. Desenvolver estratégias de prevenção de incapacidades, quedas, imobilidade, dor e perda funcional. Orientar pacientes, familiares e cuidadores quanto às condutas terapêuticas, exercícios, adaptações ambientais e promoção do autocuidado. Atuar de forma integrada com médicos, enfermeiros, terapeutas ocupacionais, nutricionistas, psicólogos e demais profissionais da equipe multiprofissional. Registrar avaliações, evoluções e condutas no prontuário eletrônico, garantindo a qualidade das informações assistenciais. Participar de discussões clínicas, reuniões multidisciplinares e construção compartilhada dos planos de cuidado. Atuar em conformidade com os protocolos assistenciais, princípios éticos e valores da Laços Saúde. Requisitos Graduação completa em Fisioterapia. Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO). Experiência em atendimento fisioterapêutico, preferencialmente com pessoas idosas. Disponibilidade para atendimentos domiciliares. Experiência em Atenção Primária à Saúde, Estratégia Saúde da Família, Atenção Domiciliar ou Saúde Comunitária. Pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas: Fisioterapia Neurofuncional; Fisioterapia Traumato-Ortopédica; Geriatria e Gerontologia. Sobre Nós Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Create a standardized platform for engineers to develop, test, deploy, and update agents safely. Create dashboards, alerting, and incident-response processes for agent and platform health. Diagnose failures across application code, model behavior, third‑party tools, networks, containers, virtual machines, and cloud infrastructure. Improve the efficiency and resilience of the platform as agent usage and workload complexity grow. Work closely with product engineers and internal teams to convert promising agent prototypes into dependable production systems. Establish best practices for developing and operating autonomous agents across Commure. Strong proficiency in Python, which will be the primary language for agent development, platform tooling, integrations, and automation. Excellent familiarity with Linux environments and hands‑on experience developing, deploying, and debugging software on virtual machines. Strong Bash and command‑line skills, including shell scripting, process management, networking diagnostics, filesystem operations, package management, and log investigation. Experience managing software across fleets of virtual machines, including configuration, deployment, monitoring, access management, and failure recovery. Strong hands‑on experience building and operating production systems on Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, including compute, networking, storage, identity and access management, and observability. Experience deploying and managing Linux virtual machines and containerized workloads in cloud environments. Hands‑on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized production workloads. Experience building infrastructure, deployment systems, internal developer platforms, or distributed application runtimes. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, secrets management, and automated deployments. Hands‑on experience building with large language models, autonomous agents, or agent harnesses. An understanding of agent concepts such as tool calling, memory, context management, planning, retries, evaluations, permissions, and human‑in‑the‑loop execution. Experience monitoring and debugging distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. A strong understanding of production reliability, including failure recovery, idempotency, rate limiting, concurrency management, and incident response. The ability to balance fast experimentation with the security and reliability required for production systems. Strong ownership and communication skills, including comfort working across product, infrastructure, security, and operational teams. A builder mindset and excitement about creating infrastructure for a rapidly evolving category of software. Nice to Have You have built, extended, deployed, or operated an OpenClaw agent. You have contributed to OpenClaw or another open‑source agent framework. Experience operating a fleet of autonomous or long‑running AI agents. Experience building multi‑tenant agent platforms or internal developer platforms. Experience with agent evaluation, tracing, replay, simulation, or regression testing. Experience with browser agents, computer‑use agents, or agents that interact with external systems. Familiarity with model gateways, inference providers, prompt versioning, token accounting, and LLM cost optimization. Experience securing workloads that access sensitive data or high‑impact production tools. Familiarity with Swift and experience contributing to or supporting native Apple client applications. Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or another regulated industry. Reduce the time required to take an agent from prototype to production. Improve safeguards around credentials, permissions, tool execution, and sensitive data. Improve the reliability, repeatability, and security of our Linux VM and Kubernetes‑based agent environments. Create a platform that allows Commure teams to build increasingly capable agents without reinventing the underlying infrastructure. description: A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, no Rio de Janeiro, com foco na elaboração de projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Ao longo da nossa trajetória, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, atendendo grandes players como Petrobras, Braskem, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau, em segmentos como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico, alimentício, siderúrgico e infraestrutura. Atuamos com tecnologias avançadas, como laser scan, drones e integração ao modelo BIM, sempre buscando soluções mais eficientes, seguras e inovadoras para nossos clientes. Contamos com um Sistema de Gestão Integrado (SGI) robusto, certificado internacionalmente nas normas ISO 9001:2015 (Qualidade), ISO 14001:2015 (Gestão Ambiental) e ISO 45001:2018 (Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional), refletindo nosso compromisso com excelência operacional, sustentabilidade e segurança. Nosso sistema é amplamente reconhecido e já foi aprovado em auditorias conduzidas por diversos clientes, garantindo a execução de projetos críticos com alto padrão de qualidade e confiabilidade. Mais do que entregar projetos, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com excelência, inovação e evolução contínua. RESPONSABILIDADES Desenvolver e elaborar documentos técnicos, desenhos e modelos necessários para compor os projetos de engenharia de unidades industriais e utilidades, assegurando aderência às premissas de processo, requisitos de segurança, normas técnicas e integração entre disciplinas; Interpretar e detalhar premissas, PFDs, PIDs, arranjos gerais e listas técnicas; Elaborar desenhos 2D e/ou modelos 3D (CAD/BIM) conforme padrões e normas aplicáveis: arranjos, layouts, detalhes construtivos, isométricos; Participar de reuniões técnicas de integração entre disciplinas; registrar decisões e ações; Realizar adequações com base em interferências identificadas em maquetes 3D (clash detection) e revisões técnicas. Aplicar padrões gráficos, simbologias e templates definidos pelo cliente/contratante; cumprir convenções de tags; Incorporar requisitos de segurança de processo, acessibilidade, operação e manutenção (operabilidade/manutenibilidade) nos arranjos e rotas. Atualizar documentos conforme revisões ou alterações de escopo; gestão de revisões e histórico. Utilizar softwares CAD/BIM específicos (como AutoCAD, EPLAN, Solid Works, inventor, impressora 3D, vision, briks CAD, etc.) para criação e revisão de desenhos técnicos e modelos. Desenvolver isométricos de tubulação; Atualizar desenhos conforme revisões de projeto; Participar de reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares; Realizar compatibilização de projetos. title: Digital Product Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Commercial & Marketing Location Brazil THE POSITION FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role indefining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies. Value Generation : Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data-driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience Product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities. Competencies Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complimented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment, excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision-making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations and executive-ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. description: Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada. Sobre a Oportunidade Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas. Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar as Cefalometrias e as fotos para realizar a documentação de Ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário. Realização de procedimentos básicos juntos aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiografias) sempre com supervisão do Dentista. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior. title: Change Order Manager
description: Position Summary The Change Order Manager will lead change order budget creation activities between project management, functional leads, and the financial analysts in order to develop, explain, and provide variance analysis for the change orders in preparation for presentation to the client. The Change Order Manager will contribute to the tracking and record keeping of change order requests in order to develop departmental metrics, and lead and/or actively participate in internal and client calls on a routine basis. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: Work collaboratively with project management, financial analysts, functional leads, and other contributing parties in order to produce a high-quality change order which is meaningful, accurate, and in accordance with the changes in assumptions on a timely basis. Provide review of changes in assumptions to the budget in order to work with the extended project team to identify information gaps and/or discrepancies, unique service requirements in order to translate information into budgets. Actively communicate with the project team and other key stakeholders both within and outside the organization in order to support the timely and accurate delivery of change orders. Schedule and lead the change order alignment calls with the extended project team. Prepare, edit, and customize change order text to accurately reflect the strategic message, changes in assumptions, budget summaries, changes in resourcing, and additional financial requirements. Incorporate vendor and partner change orders into the main change order as applicable while ensuring accuracy and completeness. Ensure all information is accurate and clearly stated including assumptions, processes described, changes from prior executed agreements inclusive of resourcing updates, timeline shifts, country/site/patient changes, etc. Meticulous attention to the use of financial formulas to ensure an accurate change order which includes, but not limited to: cross checks, formula review, reasonable testing, etc. Qualifications Minimum Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in science, finance/accounting or related business field. Other Required A minimum of 5 years’ experience in proposal and/or change order preparation in an excel based costing tool and preparation of change order/contract documents Working knowledge of project budgets, financial analysis, advanced excel skills with a meticulous attention to detail. Preferred MBA Preferred Experience in the CRO industry Competencies Working knowledge of the life cycle of a project with a solid foundation of how the changes in assumptions impact the costings/budget and financial impact at each stage of the clinical trial. Strong Excel/Microsoft Office skills and ability to thrive in a multi-tasking environment. Strong financial skills combined with an attention and appreciation to detail. High energy and enthusiasm with a strong commitment to exceeding expectations. Flexibility and willingness to work on multiple assignments of varying tasks with personnel throughout the organization. Ability to learn quickly. Good oral and written communication & interpersonal skills with the ability to connect and build relationships with management and others throughout the organization. Exhibits self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment. Team player with a desire to be an active, long-term participant in the growth of the company. Travel required Travel will be minimal. Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
